question: In a certain code language, HEART is written as USAFI and CLEANER is written as SFOAFMD. How will SHAMPOO be written as in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9985dd8f74750c629823c3946c05df004da792102bc4f662d139761e5e452694.png] 

The logic followed here is,

HEART is written as USAFI,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bd228272c7fe85be0ab3018a0ab3f54700a14630c1c0743d4cd1cf01dfe9fee1.png] 

CLEANER is written as SFOAFMD,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0beba4ec3b52a2bb251dad5f3edac521788155647d1677922571318938e55695.png] 

Similarly,

**SHAMPOO can be written as,**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e1b9fe87f111a1d0b63c2e9609e3890a8971f4beaee64ae4b7f85e680d49775e.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1"**.
